results.title: Dish TV Q1 loss more than triples to Rs 286 crore; VZY sales cross Rs 200 crore
results.description: Dish TV India reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 286 crore for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, as subscription revenue fell 41% to Rs 161 crore. Total expenses rose 46% amid shifting consumer viewing habits, while the company continued expanding its VZY Smart TV ecosystem to drive connected entertainment.
